node.statement: Fix n and Y in M_n tensor S^{A_R}_{P^R,Q^R}. By lem-compcb-amplified-compression and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities inside A_R, this space is the range of the idempotent F_n=Co^{A_R}_{P^R_n,Q^R_n}, so F_n(Y)=Y. The def-compressed-corner comparison in A_R therefore gives ||Y-P^R_n dot_R (Y dot_R Q^R_n)||<=K_def*(C_proj+2*C_ca)t||Y|| (and likewise for the other association), after the universal threshold is imposed.
